review_candidates.description: Solutions Consultant | Oslo What if your next tech role didn't make you choose between people and technology? At ConnectMyApps, Solutions Consultants work with both. We build integrations for client across Europe that make their business applications work together, across HR, finance, ERP, CRM and more. We're growing our Customer Solutions team and are looking for a Solutions Consultant to join us in Oslo. What you'll do You'll work across the whole customer journey, from first conversations and onboarding to solution design, implementation, testing and ongoing support. That includes: → Working out what the customer is trying to achieve, even before the requirements are technical → Exploring what customer and third-party systems can (and can't) do, and how their APIs let them talk to each other → Turning business needs into clear technical specifications → Using AI to help turn those specifications into reliable integrations, then reviewing, validating and refining → Leading test sessions with customers and stakeholders → Working closely with customers, partners and our team to make it all work in the real world This isn't a traditional developer role. We want someone who thinks first and builds second: someone who can look at a problem, understand what's going on, ask the right questions, find a solution and explain it clearly to everyone involved. You don't need to be an experienced coder, but you should be curious about how technology works and willing to find your way around solution components and code. What we're looking for Someone who moves comfortably between people, business and technology. You: → Communicate and present well, and are comfortable in front of customers → Can turn business conversations into technical requirements, and explain technical ideas in plain language → Understand APIs and how systems work together → Think logically and enjoy solving problems → Pick up unfamiliar systems quickly → Have used or experimented with AI agents for coding and/or document generation → Enjoy variety: different systems, industries and problems → Are comfortable with fast pace and having to switch context between projects → Are a real team player New graduates are welcome. We care more about potential, curiosity and mindset than years of experience. Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language is a must. Other languages are a bonus. Why ConnectMyApps? A part of The Amesto Group, ConnectMyApps was founded in 2014 with the purpose of simplifying integration and setting business free from manual data entry. We're a small team that changes the way companies work. Here you'll work directly with customers and see the impact of what you build. Many of the tools and improvements we use today came from the team's own ideas. So, when you see a better way of doing something, we want to hear it, and we want you to explore it. You won't just follow an established process. You'll help shape what our way of working looks like. We foster a strong team spirit. We have regular team events, spend time together outside work and, importantly, enjoy each other's company. You won't be one small piece of a big puzzle. You might actually leave a mark. Benefits We offer competitive salary, pension, health insurance, career development, travel and hotel discounts, Ruter discounts, mobile phone packages, discounted lunch at an excellent canteen, and discounts at selected Oslo shops and services. Location: Oslo, Norway Position type: On-site Level: Junior level Requirements: Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language required Education: University degree or similar Work permit: Must have full residency/work permit for Norway.

Pergjegjesite: • Identifikimi i mundesive te reja te biznesit dhe zhvillimi i marredhenieve me kliente, arkitekte, projektues dhe kompani ndertimi. • Analizimi i kerkesave dhe dokumentacionit te projektit per te propozuar zgjidhje ndricimi sipas funksionit, specifikimeve teknike dhe buxhetit. • Perzgjedhja e produkteve dhe pergatitja e ofertave teknike e financiare, ne bashkepunim me ekipin. • Prezantimi i zgjidhjeve te propozuara, negocimi i kushteve tregtare dhe ndjekja e procesit te shitjes. • Planifikimi dhe ndjekja e projekteve te ndricimit, nga konfirmimi i porosise deri ne dorezim. • Koordinimi me furnitoret, ekipet teknike dhe kontraktoret per porosite, furnizimin dhe instalimin. • Monitorimi i afateve, kostove dhe cilesise se realizimit, si dhe zgjidhja e problematikave gjate projektit. • Kryerja e vizitave ne terren per verifikimin e nevojave dhe perputhshmerise se zbatimit me zgjidhjen e miratuar. • Ndjekja e testimeve funksionale, dorezimit dhe kerkesave te klientit pas shitjes. • Raportimi mbi ecurine e shitjeve, statusin e projekteve dhe detyrimet e pagesave. Kerkesat: ✔ Diplome ne Inxhinieri Elektrike ose fusha te aferta. ✔ Mbi 4 vite eksperience ne shitje teknike, projektim ose zbatim elektrik, me eksperience konkrete ne projekte ndricimi. ✔ Eksperience ne analizimin e kerkesave, propozimin e zgjidhjeve dhe ndjekjen e te pakten 2 projekteve te ndricimit. ✔ Njohuri mbi produktet e ndricimit, specifikimet teknike dhe aplikimin e tyre ne ambiente te ndryshme. ✔ Aftesi per leximin dhe interpretimin e projekteve elektrike dhe planeve te ndricimit. ✔ Njohuri ne AutoCAD dhe Microsoft Office; njohja e DIALux perben avantazh. ✔ Aftesi ne prezantim, negocim dhe menaxhim te marredhenieve me klientet. ✔ Aftesi organizative dhe koordinimi te disa projekteve njekohesisht. ✔ Njohuri te mira te anglishtes dhe/ose italishtes. ✔ Patente e kategorise B dhe gatishmeri per vizita ne terren. Ne ofrojme: • Page ne perputhje me eksperiencen dhe aftesite. • Skeme bonusi e lidhur me rezultatet e shitjeve dhe realizimin e projekteve. • Trajnime teknike mbi produktet dhe zgjidhjet e ndricimit. • Mundesi zhvillimi profesional ne shitje teknike dhe menaxhim projektesh. • Perfshirje ne projekte te ndryshme ndricimi dhe bashkepunim me arkitekte, projektues dhe profesioniste te fushes. • Mbeshtetje nga ekipi teknik gjate pergatitjes dhe realizimit te projekteve. • Mjete pune dhe mbulim i shpenzimeve te levizjeve per nevoja pune.

Responsabilidades del puesto Desarrollo y mantenimiento de servicios backend eficientes y escalables con Python y FastAPI. Implementación de sistemas de mensajería y notificaciones de eventos. Optimización del rendimiento de los procesos. Colaboración para el diseño de soluciones escalables y bien estructuradas en el cloud. Revisiones de código e implementación de pruebas con PyTest, así como análisis de datos utilizando Pandas y NumPy. Experiencia requerida: Experiencia en desarrollo backend con Python. Puesto estable en proyectos de larga duración. Modalidad de trabajo 100% remota. Rango salarial: 25 - 28k. Salario en 14 pagas. Jornada intensiva los viernes y durante los meses de julio y agosto. Beneficios: Día libre el día de tu cumpleaños y día libre de asuntos propios. Plan de retribución flexible: tarjeta restaurante y tarjeta transporte. Seguro médico privado y acceso a WellHub. Descuentos en servicios, productos y formaciones por trabajar en Logicalis. Formación y certificaciones adaptadas al puesto de trabajo. Desarrollo profesional en proyectos punteros y con tecnologías actuales del mercado.

review_candidates.title: Backend Software Engineer 3
review_candidates.description: Full-time Job Opportunity [No visa sponsorship available at this time] Remote work No Third Part or vendor resumes please Must have experience in enterprise or commercial software development and solution integrations. Must have a healthcare industry background to be considered for this role Job Summary Backend Engineers design, build, and maintain reliable software integrations that connect products, platforms, and systems across a variety of interfaces and technologies. In this role, they develop secure, scalable, and maintainable backend solutions while helping establish engineering standards, patterns, and best practices. The focus of this position is to integrate full-stack web applications with third-party software and platforms, including EMR/EHR systems, CRM technologies, telephony products, and AI applications. Engineers in this role will build and leverage real-time interfaces, as well as create data pipelines to move data between applications, databases, and data lakes. Duties And Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain APIs, data services, and microservices that securely exchange data with internal systems and external partners. Develop effective data models, data flows, and pipelines to support reliable storage, transformation, and transfer of data across systems. Integrate third party systems and tools through real time custom or standardized interfaces. Implement secure integrations with third-party platforms, SaaS products, and cloud-based services. Collaborate with cross-functional technical and business teams to understand requirements and translate them into practical, maintainable engineering solutions. Drive feature development from requirements refinement, design, implementation and maintenance. Providing sound architecture and alignment with established standards. Contribute to a DevOps culture through automated testing, source control, deployment automation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of development and delivery processes. Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and architecture decisions. Continuously document code, technical designs, framework standards, data processes, and team practices. Troubleshoot complex data, application, integration, and performance issues and develop sustainable solutions Education And Professional Experience Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or a related technical field. 8 years of experience in enterprise or commercial software development and solution integrations. Experience integrating with EMR/EHR systems like Athena, ECW and/or Epic Demonstrated experience developing data-intensive products using database technologies such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Cosmos. Expertise in developing and integrating REST APIs, GraphQL interfaces, webhooks, web sockets and pub/sub technologies. Strong SQL skills and the ability to design and code complex query logic and data transformation workflows. Professional development experience with at least one procedural or object-oriented programming language, preferably including multiple languages such as Scala, Typescript, C#, Java or Python. Experience with cloud platforms and data services, preferably within Azure and/or AWS environments. Experience with source control and software development practices, preferably including Git and automated build/deployment processes. Experience working with healthcare data. Additional Experience That Is Beneficial Includes Enterprise Data Warehouse, Data Lake, Big Data, unstructured data, or in-memory data store technologies. NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra or Cosmos DB. Cloud-based data movement and management using technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Service Bus, Kafka, Redis, Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Azure Automation, machine learning services, or Elasticsearch. Distributed data processing technologies such as Spark or Hadoop. PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES Software Engineering: Applies sound software engineering principles to develop clean, maintainable, testable, and scalable solutions. Able to work independently and develop complete and robust features. Data Engineering: Demonstrates strong understanding of data ingestion, transformation, integration, storage, data quality, and data lifecycle management. Database Expertise: Understands database architecture, SQL development, query optimization, indexing, data modeling, and performance tuning. Cloud & Architecture: Effectively evaluates and applies cloud services, distributed architectures, object-oriented design principles, and resiliency patterns. Problem Solving: Breaks down complex technical problems, evaluates alternatives, and develops pragmatic solutions based on business and technical requirements. Delivery Focus: Prioritizes shipping useful, sustainable solutions while remaining aware of scalability, maintainability, and technical debt. Must be able to estimate work and adhere to negotiated schedules. Collaboration: Works effectively with software engineers, data engineers, analysts, data scientists, architects, and business stakeholders. Communication: Clearly communicates technical concepts, design decisions, risks, and recommendations in both written and verbal formats. Ownership & Accountability: Takes ownership of individual work and contributes to shared team outcomes, including successes, challenges, and continuous improvement. Documentation: Consistently documents code, designs, processes, standards, and technical decisions. Compensation Standard benefits (PTO, Medical, Dental etc.) Salary - 130k - 135K SE3 has a 10% annual bonus.

Works with IT and Business Leadership to promote innovative and integrated solutions across the organization and demonstrates proficiency in all aspects of the System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) through requirements gathering, project leadership, architecting, developing, testing, modifying and supporting enterprise application systems for internal and external customers as well as vendor partners. Responsibilities Essential Duties and Responsibilities Holds primary technical responsibility for software development and enhancements as well as system reliability of business-critical applications and integration processes. Acts as the technical lead for projects related to the development of new systems, architecture, applications or technology capabilities in support of business goals. Works with stakeholders on interpretation/translation of functional requirements into system requirements. Designs and develops web and mobile applications along with related internal and vendor partner system integrations and services utilizing distributed computing fundamentals and reactive principles as required. Creates appropriate technical artifacts to support development and operations support within SDLC guidelines and application/architecture diagrams and logic flows. Writes quality code that meets standards and delivers desired functionality using the technology selected for the project and delivers easy to operate systems by performing unit, system, automated testing, and post deployment validation design. Coordinates user acceptance testing. Adheres to and drives modern software engineering, by applying Agile and DevOps methodologies with an iterative development approach. Migrates or transforms legacy solutions to micro services/cloud native. Implements architecture, solution design, and development of core platform. Integrates monitoring, logging and metrics frameworks into every application and platform effort. Troubleshoots application issues by diagnosing and debugging issues within production systems by performing thorough root cause analysis. Ensures alignment with corporate standards and strategic technology decisions. Maintains and improves technology proficiency with evolving technologies to achieve desired technical and business outcomes. Stays current on technologies, platforms, and relevant certification. Provides training and mentoring to other IT staff and business users at all levels of the organization. Finds ways to spread learning across the organization (gives technical talks, presentations, etc.) and mentors lower-level staff. Learns, evaluates, recommends and adapts to new technologies and techniques. Requires availability for periodic on call responsibilities. Leads the evaluation, planning and implementation of applications/systems and programming needs for operating departments. Works closely with IT and Business Area leadership to define and implement IT-wide application and related infrastructure vision and long-term strategy in support of business objectives. Leads software projects from department-specific to, enterprise-wide and customer- and vendor-facing implementations. Estimates projects including assessing and mitigating risk. Manages project budgets as well internal and consulting resources for any size projects or software. Performs project planning, system analysis, software design and coding, testing, documentation, implementation and research activities as necessary for software engineering projects. Provides technical leadership and leads proofs of concept through development of valuation matrices through final recommendation, including hands-on execution where needed. Develops business case(s) to recommend system solutions and architectures and performs ongoing capacity planning for critical infrastructure. Leads RFP efforts from gathered business and system requirements. Conducts security architecture design reviews and threat modeling. Leads the IT application area effort on security audits and compliance reviews. Ensures all compliance aspects of position are known and followed; understands and complies with all policies, codes and regulations applicable to position and company. Performs related duties as assigned. Qualifications Essential Education, Skills, and Environment Education and Work Experience Bachelor's degree from an accredited school and 5 years of related progressive work experiences as software development. Demonstrated knowledge of: Modern and reactive programming concepts which include cloud native design, micro services, containerization, cloud model architectures, distributed high volume computing design. Application, service monitoring, and code instrumentation. Working with event-driven, streaming architectures using Kafka. Working with deployment topologies ensuring applications for resiliency and continuous availability. Working with containers and container management like Kubernetes. Technical knowledge with hands-on java + Spring Framework and related Spring ecosystem, development and deployment of Apple and Android mobile apps, test driven development, DevOps via CI/CD, automated configuration, provisioning and deployment, application security and identity management and related development techniques including secrets management. Relational (Oracle, SQL, PL/SQL, PostgreSQL) and no SQL databases (Couchbase) development, testing automation tools and approaches. Demonstrated skills such as: Communicate effectively via multiple changes (written and verbal communication skills including composing and delivering executive level presentations) with technical and non- technical staff Interpersonal, analytical, problem-solving, initiative, and the ability to thrive under pressure and with changes in requirements Project management with the ability to prioritize and handling multiple tasks and projects concurrently. review_candidates.title: Senior Software Developer - Flight Controller (m/f/d)
review_candidates.company: Halian | Managed Services, Recruitment Agency & Contract Staffing
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: Role Overview We are seeking a Lead Software Developer to lead the development, integration, and delivery of embedded flight software for advanced autonomous platforms. This is a hands-on technical leadership position combining embedded software architecture, flight-control development, platform integration, security, debugging, validation, and team leadership . The successful candidate will contribute directly to engineering activities while guiding a software team through the complete product lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Lead the design, development, integration, and validation of embedded flight software for autonomous and safety-critical platforms. Own software architecture and technical decisions across flight-control and embedded systems. Lead platform bring-up, software integration, debugging, validation, and firmware release activities. Integrate platform security features, secure boot, trusted execution environments, and secure software deployment mechanisms. Develop and review production-quality embedded software using C/C++, with Python used for tooling and test automation. Provide technical leadership, code reviews, mentoring, and engineering guidance to software teams. Work closely with hardware, systems, security, test, manufacturing, and DevOps engineering teams. Support Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, automated builds, testing, configuration control, and release management. Ensure software meets required standards for reliability, maintainability, security, and safety-critical development. Represent the software function in technical discussions with internal and external stakeholders. Experience 15+ years of embedded software engineering experience. 8+ years working with flight controllers, autopilot software, avionics, or comparable safety-critical embedded systems. Demonstrated experience leading embedded software teams and taking complex products from development through integration, validation, and production release. Strong hands-on background in autonomous platforms, UAVs, aerospace systems, robotics, or similarly complex real-time embedded environments. Technical Skills Advanced C/C++ development for real-time embedded systems. Python for tooling, scripting, test automation, and engineering workflows. Hands-on experience with autopilot / flight-control stacks such as PX4 or equivalent. Experience integrating MAVLink and Ground Control Stations such as QGroundControl or equivalent. Strong experience with RTOS environments such as NuttX, including scheduling, POSIX interfaces, IPC, memory protection, and device drivers. Development experience on ARM Cortex-based platforms. Embedded security experience including ARM TrustZone, OP-TEE, Trusted Firmware, secure boot chains, eFUSE, and OTP. Low-level peripheral integration using CAN-FD, SPI, I2C, and UART. Secure coding practices including MISRA C and SEI CERT. Applied cryptography knowledge including TLS, AES, RSA, ECC, PKI, and key management. Strong working knowledge of Git, including branching strategies, pull requests, merge workflows, and code reviews. Experience with embedded software CI/CD and DevOps, using technologies such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions. Experience with automated firmware build, test, release, and configuration-management processes. Working knowledge of MATLAB or equivalent engineering tools for test automation, data analysis, simulation, and validation. Ability to make software architecture decisions, mentor engineers, and lead cross-functional technical discussions. Education & Certifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Master's degree or PhD is advantageous. Knowledge or certification relating to safety-critical software standards such as DO-178C and/or ISO 26262 is highly desirable. Experience using MATLAB or similar tools within test and validation workflows is preferred. Industry / Domain: Autonomous Systems | Flight Control | Embedded Software | Safety-Critical Systems | Embedded Security Senior Software Developer - Flight Controller in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
